Lina (Design): quick sync onboarding checklist: should the first-run checklist be a small popover anchored to the top-right or a full modal that blocks the rest of the Console? Prototype links: popover https://img.mock/checklist-pop-2150.png modal https://img.mock/checklist-modal-2150.png. Main concerns: scanability, keyboard flow, and dismissal persistence. Thoughts? Omar (Product): Popover is less disruptive, better for returning users. Modal is more attention-grabbing for brand-new workspaces. Metrics: completion of checklist steps within 3 days, and dismiss rate. We can A/B test. Ruth (Research): From interviews: users disliked modals that felt like forced tutorials. They preferred contextual surfaces that let them continue working. However, novices appreciated a focused modal for the first 10 minutes. Suggest: default to popover, but show modal for accounts with zero activity after signup for 48h. Zed (Frontend): Implementation notes: popover must be keyboard-trap-free. If popover is open and user tabs, focus should cycle inside popover until they press Escape or click outside. For accessibility, set `role=dialog` for modal and `role=tooltip` or `region` for popover with `aria-modal=false`. Also provide `data-feature-flag` for gated rollout. Example snippet: ```html
...
``` Ava (A11y): A few a11y nits: 1) If popover contains interactive checklist items, it should be focusable and include `aria-live="polite"` when steps update. 2) Dismiss button needs `aria-label=\"Close onboarding checklist\"`. 3) Ensure contrast on step numbers badges meets 3:1 since they may be small. Lina (Design): Copy thoughts for primary CTAs: `Complete setup` vs `Finish setup steps` vs `Walk me through`. For the popover we should use shorter copy: `Complete setup`. Modal can use friendlier tone: `Let's finish your workspace`. Omar (Product): Agree. We'll experiment: Variant P (popover + CTA: "Complete setup"), Variant M (modal + CTA: "Let's finish your workspace"). Add events: `onboard_checklist_shown`, `onboard_checklist_step_complete`, `onboard_checklist_dismiss`. Include `variant=P|M`. Zed (Frontend): Regarding persistence: store `onboard_checklist_shown_at` and `onboard_checklist_dismissed` in user prefs. Dismiss should hide for 7 days. If user completes any checklist step, hide permanently. PR will include client opt-out and server flag. Also will respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for modal transitions. Ava (A11y): Extra: keyboard order for popover should be: close -> steps (in order) -> primary CTA -> secondary link. If we auto-focus inside the popover, ensure focus restore to the triggering element on close. Ruth (Research): We'll run a 7-day qualitative microtest with 20 new signups: 10 popover, 10 modal. Capture time-to-first-task and subjective interruption score. Lina (Design): Visual tweak: make step items compact with 12px vertical spacing and add clear success state (green check + `aria-checked`). I'll update Figma and attach tokens. DeployBot: Canary build deployed to staging (#4621) with popover default and variant flags. Zed (Frontend): Draft PR posted: https://git.mock/r/redwood/console/pull/904. Includes analytics, focus management, and persistence hooks. Needs a11y sign-off from Ava and design spacing check from Lina. Omar (Product): Please review PR by EOD Friday. If a11y approves, we'll flip 10% modal for the experiment next week. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
